payload.summary: Caring Contacts: postgres-repository.ts is ~2,080 lines and holds five self-contained clusters
payload.detail: src/lib/caring-contacts/db/postgres-repository.ts would split naturally into sibling modules under db/. Pure structure, no behaviour change; the file is the code half of row-level security so any split must keep every method's set_config/set local role preamble intact and be proved by the existing shared contract suite.
